content.short: DAOLama is a decentralized protocol where users can use their NFTs as collateral for instant loans in TON.
content.description: DAOLama is an innovative decentralized lending protocol that unlocks the financial value of NFTs on the TON blockchain. It allows users to use their digital collectibles as collateral to obtain instant, non-custodial loans in Toncoin. This provides NFT holders with much-needed liquidity without requiring them to sell their prized assets. By providing a secure and efficient peer-to-protocol lending mechanism, DAOLama enhances the overall utility of NFTs in the TON ecosystem, bridging the gap between digital art and decentralized finance.
content.meta: Unlock liquidity from your NFTs with DAOLama. Instant loans using NFTs as collateral on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
